adoption_status: experimental-opt-in; aggregate gains did not eliminate holdout completeness regression
execution_surface: Available collaboration tools in the active coding agent session; no standalone unattended runtime assumed
authorization: Dispatch only when user or applicable instructions authorize specialist-agent work
shared_rules: No WMS code changes, database connections, commit/push or external messages during analysis evaluation
Preserve client/branch scope; unknown is not universal
Do not expose secrets or full SQL definitions
Cite exact source spans with SHA256; preserve immutable git_ref for historical branches
Treat graph edges as possible syntax dependencies, not runtime proof
Do not read evaluation oracles when generating findings/answers
State evidence gaps and contradictions; do not resolve by majority vote
Use narrow source reads and selective graph queries
acceptance: All source hashes and literal spans validate
Every material factual claim has reviewed evidence
Unknown applicability and unresolved contradictions remain explicit
Generated answer quality is compared against a frozen baseline
Resource overhead and missing cost data are reported
Do not promote workflow merely because more agents ran
